title: Veterans Day Silent Vigil
seo_title: Veterans Day Silent Vigil in Lebanon, MO – Nov. 11, 2026
description: The Veterans Day Silent Vigil is Lebanon's first, a day-long tribute honoring those who served. Veterans, service members, and military families are invited to participate. It takes place Wednesday, November 11, 2026, starting at 10:45 AM at the Veterans Memorial, 500 East Elm Street, Lebanon, MO.
